WELCOME.TITLE: Welcome to MadHousing
WELCOME.BODY: Your tool to explore Madrid's real estate market. Visualize properties, analyze areas and make better-informed decisions.

SEARCH.TITLE: Search with filters
SEARCH.BODY: Use the Search panel in the top bar to filter by price, size, rooms, floor and many more criteria. Results show up directly on the map.

MAP_MODES.TITLE: Three map modes
MAP_MODES.BODY: Switch between the heat map (property density), the choropleth (average value per area) and the pins (exact location of each property).

SCORE.TITLE: Multilevel score
SCORE.BODY: Every property has a score that combines three levels: intrinsic (price and size), contextual (proximity to urban services) and final (the weighted blend of the previous two). The higher, the better.

ENVIRONMENT.TITLE: Analyze the surroundings
ENVIRONMENT.BODY: Toggle the points-of-interest layers: transport, healthcare, education, parks, retail and bike lanes. Discover what's around each area before choosing.

SPATIAL_TOOLS.TITLE: Spatial tools
SPATIAL_TOOLS.BODY: Draw isochrones (walking, cycling or driving), trace routes between two points and apply a radius filter to see only properties within a given distance from a place.

FAVS_HISTORY.TITLE: Favorites and history
FAVS_HISTORY.BODY: Save the properties you care about to Favorites with personal notes. In History you can recover past searches and reapply their filters instantly.

STATS_COMP.TITLE: Statistics and comparator
STATS_COMP.BODY: Browse aggregate market statistics and compare two or more areas side by side to find the one that fits you best.

MORTGAGE.TITLE: Mortgage calculator
MORTGAGE.BODY: On properties for sale, compute the monthly payment from the price, down payment, term and interest rate — without leaving the map.

PREFERENCES.TITLE: Language and theme
PREFERENCES.BODY: Switch between Spanish and English, and between light and dark theme, from the top bar. The app remembers your preferences for next time.

LEYENDA_SCORE.RENT_INFO: Total price — cheaper means better score
LEYENDA_SCORE.MULTINIVEL_NOTE: The score combines price and size with proximity to transport, healthcare, education, parks, retail and bike lanes.

MAP_PANELS.RADIUS_HINT: Click on the map to set the center
MAP_PANELS.ISOCHRONE_HINT: Click on the map to compute isochrones

ROUTE.HINT_ORIGIN: Click on the map or a property to set the origin
ROUTE.HINT_DEST: Now click to set the destination
